userQuote: 是接着调整盘面（包括布局）还是先完成这能测试？我发现 F-F12 暂时用不上，而屏幕几乎被盘面占据没有给输入宿主合适的空间，导致不能看见输入内容和操控宿主应用。
scope: 18u desktop prototype usability and host workspace; no installed product/input-method/user-data changes
finding: Keyboard footprint obstructs host content and controls, limiting meaningful host acceptance.
priorityRecommendation: Record current stage, improve screen view/host workspace first, then resume remaining physical coverage after view stabilizes.

existingEvidence.reportedSoundFix: Actual-preview three clicks clear per user; separate from physical input coverage

sizeEstimate.source: Previously recorded 2880x1800 environment and latest controlled 2830x1442 render; not a new physical screen measurement
sizeEstimate.note: Only hiding F1-F12 does not remove full row: Esc, CN/EN, Layout and Pause/Break share it.

proposedView.mainWidthBaseline: 18u with existing 58.8 calibration; no automatic overall shrinking
proposedView.functionRow: Foldable screen view, complete original view retained
proposedView.essentialControls: Retain reachable Esc/cancel, CN/EN and Layout when top row is folded; preserve action semantics and key identities
proposedView.header: Compact normal-use controls; expand ruler/help/diagnostic information when needed; keep composition/candidates readable
proposedView.hostWorkspace: Keyboard at lower screen, host usable above it; choose explicit docking/window-management behavior during implementation, without assuming unrelated host windows can be changed
proposedView.initialEvaluationTarget: Approximately 40% upper-screen host space if achievable without shrinking main input keys; design target only, not an accepted physical measurement

validationOrder: Identified Word/Edge host text and caret visible, controls operable, focus binding/minimize recovery intact
Short finger and pen smoke checks on fixed view/package
Resume pending per-key physical layers, tracking view/package identity
preservation: Keep original 100-key view, 17u/23u frozen candidates, all old results and raw evidence. Do not relabel folded or moved keys as covered by earlier geometry results.
status: priority recommendation recorded; no runtime view or canonical layout geometry change applied
